name: VJ Auto Forward Bot
description: A Telegram auto-forward bot (MTProto-based) that forwards/copies message ranges between chats, with topic support, filters, and auto-pin/completion notices.

BOT_OWNER.description: Your personal Telegram numeric user ID (get from @userinfobot). The bot's admin.

DATABASE_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (e.g. from MongoDB Atlas free tier).

DATABASE_NAME.description: Name of the MongoDB database to use.

BOT_SESSION.description: Pyrogram session name — leave as default unless you have a reason to change it.

PING_URL.description: Leave empty on Heroku — RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL-style auto-detection is Render-specific. Only set this manually if you want self-ping keepalive on a platform that doesn't provide its URL automatically.

PING_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between keep-alive self-pings (only relevant if PING_URL is set).
